A row of seven simple coleoptile experiment drawings, each showing a small pale-green coleoptile growing from a little pot of soil, with yellow light arrows coming from the right-hand side in experiments 1 to 6 and no light (darkness shown by a grey background panel) in experiment 7. 1: intact coleoptile bending towards the light. 2: coleoptile with its tip removed, standing straight and short. 3: coleoptile with a black opaque cap on its tip, standing straight. 4: coleoptile with a black opaque sleeve around the part below the tip, bending towards the light. 5: tip removed and replaced on a thin pale-yellow agar block, bending towards the light. 6: a thin grey mica sheet inserted into the shaded left side just below the tip, standing straight. 7: decapitated coleoptile in darkness with a small agar block placed on its left side only, bending to the right.
